title: Development and validation of a deep reinforcement learning algorithm for auto-delineation of organs at risk in cervical cancer radiotherapy.
summary: Full PMC article reports SAM-plus-deep-reinforcement-learning auto-delineation of cervical-cancer organs at risk, compared with manual contours and commercial deep-learning software. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
ai_technology: PPO reinforcement learning selects SAM prompt points for CT organ segmentation.
organization: Cancer Center, Department of Radiation Oncology, Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital, Affiliated People's Hospital, Hangzhou Medical College, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China

evidence.tested: The represented result is improved OAR delineation for cervical radiotherapy CT.
evidence.unknown: 122 training and 28 test CT cases; DSC, HD95, ASSD and RAVD compare against manual ground truth and commercial DL.
evidence.ai_role: PPO reinforcement learning selects SAM prompt points for CT organ segmentation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
